metadata.title: UNSEEN Delhi’s Community and Food Stories l Kayasth, Sindhi, Baniya, Punjabi, Marwari | Season 1
metadata.description:
► Subscribe to Delhi Food Walks: 
https://www.youtube.com/user/Delhifoodwalks

We are thrilled to announce our upcoming series titled 'Community & Food Stories' of Delhi which is a window to the food culture of some of Delhi's numerous communities.  

It is an effort to discover Delhi's wondrous syncretic temperament through the lens of food. We had filmed it around September last year when the pandemic was on decline.

It is a soulful journey into the vibrant world of some of Delhi's numerous communities like Sindhi, Baniya, Kayasth, Punjabi and Marwari as experienced through heartwarming stories, settlement stories, festive time stories, food memories, traditional dishes and fascinating anecdotes. 

So get ready to be enthralled and enriched by this journey named COMMUNITY FOOD STORIES of Delhi starting 5th May 2021.

About the host - Anubhav Sapra
https://www.instagram.com/anubhav.sapra/
 
Anubhav Sapra is an avid culinary explorer who loves to travel and explore different cuisine primarily the street food, not just for the sake of gustatory pleasure but also for quenching his deep thirst for nurturing new cultural connections through the kaleidoscopic canvas of food. He believes that the vibrant and delectable street food tradition across the globe has the power to bring communities together and foster harmonious human existence.
 
Please subscribe to our YouTube channel to keep our Indian street food explorations video in your feed! 
 
Thank you for watching! 
 
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/delhifoodwalks 
Twitter: https://twitter.com/delhifoodwalks 
Instagram: https://instagram.com/delhifoodwalks
 
Design and filmed by Rahul Singh 
Instagram - https://www.instagram.com/iamrahulsingh.2/
 
Texts by Swetaleena Nayak
